name: map-route
description: A 3D map animation for a reel — a clean white city with parks and a river, a coloured route that draws itself from start to destination while the camera follows, a red pin that drops with a bounce, an ETA card that counts down and a destination card.
best_use_cases: Animated routes and journeys (e.g. home to gym, commutes)
style: Clean white 3D city; coloured route draws itself, camera rides along; red pin drop with bounce; ETA countdown card.
